reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown treat Vashni in 1 Chronicles 6:28 as a scribal corruption of "and the second," with the firstborn Joel's name lost from the text.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the plain reading that 1 Samuel names Joel first while 1 Chronicles 6:28 lists Vashni first, as if two different men.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah
sides.verseText: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Beersheba.

sides.snippet: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn [Joel], and the second Abijah.
sides.verseText: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn [Joel], and the second Abijah.
